basis: Locked SPEC explicitly requires a separate known-backup recovery screen, explicit consent, prior-main preservation and usable failure recovery; its restricted-session allowlist omits that mandatory mechanism. Reusing existing Protection restore ownership in that same migration/failure context fulfills the approved recovery outcome. This qualified allowlist interpretation introduces no new external effect, arbitrary source, general write permission, path family or business scope. SPEC/WO bytes stay frozen.
proposalReviewed: Terra proposes existing GET /api/protection and POST /api/restore-preview plus /api/restore, server-known backup IDs only; generated preupgrade copies discovered through durable origin/name/SHA manifest rather than loosening normal restore identity checks.
requiredBoundary: Restricted migration/failure session additionally permits only recovery status/candidates, restore-preview and explicit restore-confirm through existing endpoint names; ordinary reports/save/upload/catalog/GC and unrelated sources remain blocked.

All existing auth/Host/origin/header/strictJSON/context/main-dataset restrictions remain. Recovery confirmation has independent server-owned >=128bit nonce,300second expiry,singleuse and explicit separate consent; same nonce cannot authorize migration.

Server-generated durable preupgrade manifest records source origin,actual schema,backup name andSHA before source mutation. Select only those exact regular contained backup files, with no symlink/junction/pathescape or caller paths. Unknown/corrupt manifest and mismatched hash fail closed.

Legacy backup missing database_id may qualify only as exact manifest-bound copy of this dataset. Existing normal restore identity checks stay unchanged for all ordinary/foreign backup paths. Manifest existence alone never substitutes for full verification.

Preview and immediate preeffect confirm recheck exactbackuphash, full integrity/payload/blob validation, schema, current main state and pending/session lock. Changed source/nonce/context expires plan; verify existing main preservation before replacement. Retain selected backup and prior main; failures cannot report success.

After restoring legacy main, rotate context and return migrationRequired; stay restricted until separate explicit upgrade. After restoring schema4, construct writableStore only after verification/reinitialization succeeds. No silent migration during recovery.
Cancel/failedconfirm clear recoveryplan; UIgeneration and confirmingbusy behavior prevent stale recovery response or misleading cancellation.
requiredEvidence: Actual fault during intermediate legacy upgrade preserves source/copies and exposes recovery choice
Headed exactEXE failure recovery: knownbackup preview -> explicitconfirm -> preserved oldmain/backup -> verifiedrestoreddata -> restart -> explicitupgrade where required
Source/backup hashes and logical reports/revisions/blob identity independently compared readonly
nativeLimit: Actual browser-backed recovery flow can prove this admitted recovery outcome; it does not prove Tk/OS native dialogs and those remain NOT_TESTED unless separately exercised. Component --restore success alone is insufficient for L5/L8 consumer acceptance.
limits: Interpretation acceptance only; no implementation/product acceptance or general permission expansion.

exactCancelAndConfirmClarification.cancel: POST /api/restore-cancel {context:string}; unknownfields rejected, existing auth/Host/origin/header/context guards; restricted allowed; idempotent recovery-plan-only clear; returns {cancelled:true}, no DB effects.
exactCancelAndConfirmClarification.restrictedConfirm: POST /api/restore {context:string,nonce:string,confirmation:"KHOI PHUC"}; retain existing typed confirmation guard, no client source/path/id/digest. Server recovery nonce binds source/hash/mainstamp; explicit consent independent of migration.
exactCancelAndConfirmClarification.tests: Cancel then originalnonceconfirm409; badguard/wrongcontext leaves other plan intact; failure/expiry/contextchange consumes invalidatesplan; generation/busyguard prevents misleading cancel during effects.
exactCancelAndConfirmClarification.scope: Necessary cancellation mechanism under locked global plan contract; unchanged scope/effects/paths/authority. Earlier assessment retained.
